scope: Small, nonrepresentative household cohorts; Portuguese meters and Norwegian residential EV sessions are separate populations. No empirical arrival-SOC validation.

before.scope: portugal-realism-1 generated inputs before empirical corrections

load_calibration.objective: Mean absolute log ratio of household median metrics; equal metric weights; no held-out measured house used for selection
load_calibration.limitation: Aggregate base-load adjustment; fixed inventory energy, existing thermal/appliance priors. Calibration grid uses existing appliance schedules; final regenerated schedules are independently evaluated.

selection_history.reason: Initial optimum lay on grid boundaries; expansion used development houses only and the revised activity calendar.

ev_comparison.scope: Measured Norwegian residential AC sessions, mixed/unknown vehicle inventory, 2018-2021; compare Portuguese synthetic home resident sessions only, not workplace/visitors. No inferred batteries or SOC used. Synthetic AC input includes charger and battery losses; metering boundary may differ slightly.
ev_comparison.matched_filters: Energy >0.5 kWh; finite duration 2 minutes to 120 hours for duration/energy joint comparison; uncensored synthetic home sessions in 2024. Rates require >=10 sessions and >=60 observed days, use (n-1)/observed arrival span, not annual attendance. Duration-mode shares quantize BOTH populations to 15 minutes.
ev_comparison.interpretation: Distribution discrepancies are reported, not erased by fitting a different fleet to Norwegian observations. SOC targets and resident profile proportions remain scenario design assumptions.

retained_structures: Installed equipment, annual driving budgets and resident charging-profile composition are fixed experimental controls, not resampled population estimates.

Business opening hours and four-on/four-off night shifts are declared routines; external commercial/appliance comparisons are in commercial_appliance_validation.json, with explicit cohort and transfer limitations.
Indoor 21 C/50% fields remain inactive compatibility placeholders; no thermal comfort validation.
PV sites share Lisbon weather and have different tilt/azimuth/shading; strong correlation is expected, not independent climate evidence.
Controlled topology histories, compulsory appliance jobs, full-charge preferences and impossible DR stress are benchmark assumptions.
15-minute observations cannot establish sub-minute transients, interruptions shorter than 15 minutes or realistic 15-second control.

load_comparison.boundary: Meter demand versus synthetic nonshiftable demand plus controlled appliance cycles started at their earliest allowed time. EV charging excluded because measured fleet/equipment inventory is unknown; no controller behaviour is claimed.
load_comparison.uncertainty: Households, not quarter-hour rows, are the independent bootstrap units. Small nonrandom cohort; confidence intervals do not establish nationwide representativeness. Calendar periods, equipment, electric heating and occupancy differ.

measured_house_independence.interpretation: Trace independence check only; distinct homes still share weather and population selection biases.

measured_quality_sensitivity.method: Post-hoc source-quality sensitivity: remove whole days containing raw readings above the published acquisition threshold, without interpolation, source replacement or generator retuning. Primary comparison retains raw observations.
